component.name: cometds
component.title: CometD (Secure)
component.description: Publish messages to web clients and receive their messages with the CometD/Bayeux protocol, through an embedded Jetty server.
component.label: networking,messaging

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

extensions.label: advanced
extensions.description: The list of BayeuxServer.Extension that can modify or drop the incoming and outgoing Bayeux messages. They are added to each CometD server that the component starts.

securityPolicy.label: security
securityPolicy.description: The CometD SecurityPolicy that decides whether a client may handshake, create a channel, subscribe to a channel or publish to it. It is set on each CometD server that the component starts.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: The SSL configuration of the cometds server, such as the keystore with its certificate. When set, sslKeystore, sslPassword and sslKeyPassword are not used.

sslKeyPassword.label: security
sslKeyPassword.description: The password of the keystore that sslKeystore points to, for the cometds server. Not used when SSL context parameters are configured.

sslKeystore.label: security
sslKeystore.description: The path of the keystore file with the certificate and private key of the cometds server. Not used when SSL context parameters are configured.

sslPassword.label: security
sslPassword.description: The password of the private key in the keystore that sslKeystore points to, for the cometds server. Not used when SSL context parameters are configured.

useGlobalSslContextParameters.label: security
useGlobalSslContextParameters.description: Whether the cometds server uses the global SSL context parameters of the CamelContext when sslContextParameters is not set.

CometdClientId.description: The id of the CometD session of the client that published the message, set by the consumer.

subscription.description: The subscription field of the received Bayeux message, set by the consumer when the message has this field.

consumerOut.description: The data of the Bayeux message, parsed from JSON: a String, a number or a boolean, a Map for an object, a List for an array, or null. From a cometd producer in the same JVM the body that producer sent, as is (a stream or a file as its text)

consumerReply.description: Only when the exchange is InOut (exchangePattern=InOut, or set in the route): the body the route ends with is sent back to the client that published, as JSON. A stream or a file is read as text, and null is sent as a JSON null. Bytes become an array of numbers; another object is sent as the text of its toString

producerIn.description: The data published to the channel, sent as JSON to the subscribed clients: text, a number or a boolean, a Map or a List. A stream or a file is read as text, and null is published as a JSON null. Bytes become an array of numbers; another object is sent as the text of its toString: convert it first. The headers go in the ext field of the message

host.description: The host name or IP address that the embedded Jetty server listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all network interfaces; localhost accepts only local connections.

port.description: The TCP port that the embedded Jetty server listens on. The producers and consumers with the same scheme, host and port share one server.

channelName.description: The name of the Bayeux channel, which is the path of the URI, such as /channel/orders. The consumer receives the messages that clients publish to this channel, and the producer publishes to the clients that subscribe to it.

allowedOrigins.description: The comma-separated list of origins that the cross-origin filter allows, such as https://app.example.com. A * in an origin matches any characters, * alone allows every origin, and the filter allows credentials only when every origin is named without a *. Used only when crossOriginFilterOn is true.

allowedTransports.description: A comma-separated list of transport names allowed by the CometD server (e.g. websocket, long-polling, callback-polling). callback-polling is the JSONP transport mechanism. This option applies to the shared CometD server on the host and port; the first endpoint to configure the server sets this value.

baseResource.description: The directory of static web resources that the server serves from the root path, with the prefix file: for the file system or classpath: for the classpath, such as classpath:webapp. Without a value the server serves no static resources. The first endpoint that starts the server of the host and port sets it.

crossOriginFilterOn.description: Whether the server adds the Jetty CrossOriginFilter, which answers the CORS requests of the origins in allowedOrigins. The filter is mapped to filterPath, so set that option too. The first endpoint that starts the server of the host and port sets it.

filterPath.description: The servlet path pattern that the cross-origin filter is mapped to, such as /cometd/*. Used only when crossOriginFilterOn is true; without a value the filter applies to no request.

interval.description: The time in milliseconds that the server tells the clients to wait after a /meta/connect reply before they send the next /meta/connect request; 0 means at once. The first endpoint that starts the server of the host and port sets it.

jsonCommented.description: Passed to the CometD servlet as the JSONCommented parameter, which CometD 9 does not read, so it has no effect.

logLevel.description: Passed to the CometD servlet as the logLevel parameter, which CometD 9 does not read, so it has no effect. Set the level of the org.cometd loggers in the logging configuration instead.

maxInterval.description: The time in milliseconds that the server waits for the next /meta/connect request of a client before it removes the session of that client. The first endpoint that starts the server of the host and port sets it.

multiFrameInterval.description: Passed to the CometD servlet as the multiFrameInterval parameter, which CometD 9 does not read, so it has no effect.

timeout.description: The time in milliseconds that the server holds a /meta/connect request (the long poll of a client) while it has no message to deliver, before it replies. The first endpoint that starts the server of the host and port sets it.

sessionHeadersEnabled.label: consumer
sessionHeadersEnabled.description: Whether the consumer adds the attributes of the CometD session of the publishing client as headers, one header per attribute name. Only String, Integer, Long, Double and Boolean values are added; the other attributes are skipped.

exceptionHandler.label: consumer,advanced
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.label: consumer,advanced
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

disconnectLocalSession.label: producer
disconnectLocalSession.description: Whether the producer disconnects the local session of its CometD service after each message it publishes to the channel. CometD does not sweep local sessions, so they stay in the server until they are disconnected.

headerFilterStrategy.label: advanced
headerFilterStrategy.description: A custom HeaderFilterStrategy for the headers that are copied between the Camel message and the ext field of the Bayeux message, in both directions.
